config.sampling: round(linspace(1,N-1,10)); each t is compared to t+1 in each eye
config.temporal_amplitude: A=mean_RGB(abs(C-I)), uint8 clean/corrupt PNG promoted to integer first
config.structure_metric: S=std(A[::8,::8])*max(0,max Pearson(A(x),A(x+d))) over d=1..8 pixels, horizontal and vertical; zero when A is spatially constant or has no positive local autocorrelation
config.structure_sampling: fixed 1/8 grid only for autocorrelation; offsets remain native image pixels
config.aggregation: equal scene mean; scene-block bootstrap 10000 draws, seed 20260911
config.extraction: individual ZIP PNG members decoded to RAM
